2024_general.fact: Elections History page lists one file, 'November 5, 2024 General Election (PDF)' (DocumentCenter 411): 'BEE COUNTY, TEXAS ... Official Results ... Polling Places Reporting 12 of 12', columns Absentee/Early/Election Day/Total, county totals only, no per-precinct results (scan CreationDate Nov 18 2024). No precinct numbers published online.

2026_primary.fact: 'Official Cumulative Reports with Reconciliation (PDF)' (DocumentCenter 3104): 'Cumulative Results Report ... Official Results ... Polling Places Reporting 11 of 11 ... Run Time 10:07 AM ... Run Date 03/12/2026', county totals only; 'March 3, 2026 Preliminary Election Reconciliation' is a totals form. No per-precinct candidate results published.

2026_runoff.fact: 'Unofficial Cumulative Report w Preliminary Reconciliation (PDF)' (DocumentCenter 3269): 'Cumulative Results Report ... Unofficial Results ... Polling Places Reporting 6 of 6 ... Run Time 9:11 PM ... Run Date 05/26/2026', county totals by vote type only (PDF CreationDate May 27 02:23 UTC = 9:23 PM CDT). Official cumulative (3286, run 06/03/2026) also county totals only. No precinct numbers published online.

rationale: All three elections show county totals only (cumulative reports) and no per-precinct candidate results online, so LATER x3 gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. Low because CivicPlus DocumentCenter gives no Last-Modified upload time.

comparison_notes.2024_general: different: research UNDETERMINED; I recorded LATER because the only 2024 file (DocumentCenter 411) is a county-total Official Results report with no per-precinct candidate numbers, so precinct numbers are never published online.
comparison_notes.2026_primary: different: research says the history page lists 'only' the Preliminary Election Reconciliation and a hand count certification with 'no results file'. I recorded LATER (precinct numbers never published online).
comparison_notes.2026_runoff: same (LATER, check 2). Both read the unofficial cumulative report run 9:11 PM, county totals, CreationDate 02:23 UTC, no Last-Modified.
comparison_notes.unsupported_or_unchecked: Research claim of no 2026 primary results file is contradicted by the listed DocumentCenter 3104 file. Tag the same either way.
